maddeler.e:
نتقهقر (form IIq)
# نَتَقَهْقَرُ (nataqahqaru) /na.ta.qah.qa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# نَتَقَهْقَرَ (nataqahqara) /na.ta.qah.qa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# نَتَقَهْقَرْ (nataqahqar) /na.ta.qah.qar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
